mapper.select: SELECT unit_id,source_id,sequence,source_version,fingerprint,snapshot_hash,mapping_hash,tenant_id,application_id,environment,disposition,grant_id,tombstone FROM auth_governance.migration_record WHERE unit_id=#{unit} AND source_id=#{source}

SELECT unit_id,source_id,sequence,source_version,fingerprint,snapshot_hash,mapping_hash,tenant_id,application_id,environment,disposition,grant_id,tombstone FROM auth_governance.migration_record WHERE unit_id=#{unit} ORDER BY source_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.migration_record(unit_id,source_id,sequence,source_version,fingerprint,snapshot_hash,mapping_hash,tenant_id,application_id,environment,disposition,grant_id,tombstone) VALUES(#{r.unitId},#{r.sourceId},#{r.sequence},#{r.sourceVersion},#{r.fingerprint},#{r.snapshotHash},#{r.mappingHash},#{r.tenantId},#{r.applicationId},#{r.environment},#{r.disposition},#{r.grantId},#{r.tombstone}) ON CONFLICT(unit_id,source_id) DO UPDATE SET sequence=excluded.sequence,source_version=excluded.source_version,fingerprint=excluded.fingerprint,snapshot_hash=excluded.snapshot_hash,mapping_hash=excluded.mapping_hash, disposition=excluded.disposition,grant_id=excluded.grant_id,tombstone=excluded.tombstone,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
